properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (root-cause skill) 2026-10-18: conditionality rides BESIDE the three-valued truth (Read.assumes), and every reader that tested `holds` without reading it treated a result inside an argument as established — refutation, answers, defect standing, delivery and claimed status
properties.statement: ROOT CAUSE, walked with the root-cause skill, 2026-10-18 (item 0b of phase 3). (1) OBSERVED on the cogito trial (flo2.io 989598dd02246a81, 0.87.0): req:ai-is-res-cogitans-if reads conditional, holding only under req:suppose-ai-authentically-doubts, which nothing discharges; yet its opposing CONTRADICTS made req:ai-not-res-cogitans read REFUTED ("refuted by req:ai-is-res-cogitans-if, which holds"). Expected: contested at most, naming the supposition. Not affected: claim truth in the read-back already read `conditional` for the attacker itself. (2) SEARCHED all hub members: the nearest precedent is fact:root-cause-a-truth-computed-for-the-walk-was-served-to-the-reader-... (phase 1): one truth value serves the walk and the reader, and `conditional` was added at the READER (ClaimTruth) only. (3) CANDIDATES: implementation (objections_within read the attacker through truth_of, which keeps (truth, why) and drops the open assumptions); intent (requirement A, "an objection that holds refutes", was settled 2026-10-16, before assumptions existed on 2026-10-17, and was never revisited); the observation is wrong (the attacker holds by another, unconditional route); not in the component (the read-back, not the truth walk). (4-5) MEASURED on main b32fe1adc: the attacker's only step assumes the supposition, and the target's own premise_truth (the walk, not the reader) read fails — so the observation and the walk are confirmed and the read-back candidate is refuted. Grepped every consumer of a holding verdict and found the same drop at five places: objections_within (refutation), the same function for a reply (a conditional reply ANSWERED an objection, reinstating its target), attack_standing / is_a_standing_refutation (detect_defects' reading of an attack), holding_inferences_within (the delivery roll-up delivered a requirement a conditional step concludes) and conclusions_that_do_not_follow (a `met` resting on a conditional result went unreported). Pinned failing first on main: a_proof_states_what_it_really_does::a_claim_holding_only_under_an_open_supposition_contests_and_never_refutes_outside_it (every conditional claim of five trial fixtures set against an unconditional one), ::the_cogito_shape_... (the trial's shape, the in-scope control, and the conditional reply), and ::a_conditional_result_is_neither_delivered_nor_enough_for_a_claimed_status. (6) CLASS: conditionality lives in a side channel (Read.assumes, and since this phase Read.unverified) beside the Truth enum, and any reader that compares Truth::Holds without that channel treats a result inside an argument as established — the same class as N19 (fact:root-cause-the-generalization-check-read-only-fixes-and-never-the-assumptions-open-at-the-step-2026-10-18). (8) FIXED: each place now reads the channel; an objection is judged against its target's own reading, and one holding only under assumptions or unverified citations the target is outside STANDS (contests, `holds_only_under`) and refutes only inside the same scope. (9) NOT ESTABLISHED: that no other reader of Truth::Holds remains — the sweep covered inference.rs, reasoning.rs, reason_to_exist.rs, report.rs and heal.rs's attack readings; a structural fix (a fourth truth value) was not taken.
